notes:
Qualification summary: LumenBridge is a European fintech (transaction processing + analytics) evaluating Redwood Private VPC for customer-facing chat assistants and internal vector search for fraud signals. Key drivers: strict EU data residency, customer-managed KMS for model artifacts & logs, and full audit trails for regulators.

Security + compliance highlights (from discovery call 2026-03-04):
- Must satisfy ISO27001 & SOC2; legal wants Redwood SOC2 scope and exposure matrix.
- Data residency: all PII must remain in eu-west-1; non-PII can be multi-region but prefer eu-first routing.
- KMS: customer insists on CMK in their AWS account; requirement: Redwood Private must support AWS KMS CMK for model weights at rest and encryption of audit logs.
- Audit logging: immutable logs retained 7 years (or handed off to customer SIEM). Logs must include per-request metadata, model version, route used, and token counts.
- Network: inbound connections only via PrivateLink or VPN/Direct Connect; no public internet inbound allowed. Egress allowed but must be restricted to S3 endpoints, KMS, and Redwood control plane IP ranges (list to be provided).

Architecture fit notes (initial assessment by SE 2026-03-11):
- VPC topology: recommended pattern -- dedicated VPC with private subnets for inference nodes, NAT gateways in a separate management subnet for controlled egress, endpoints for S3 and KMS, and a Transit Gateway peering to customer network.
- Ingress: use AWS PrivateLink endpoints into customer's VPC for API facing services; alternatively, Direct Connect + routing to internal LB. No public-facing ALBs per customer policy.
- Egress controls: restrict outbound to specific AWS service endpoints and Redwood control-plane CIDR set; propose VPC endpoints for S3, KMS, and ECR.
- Regions: target eu-west-1 for primary; plan for disaster recovery in eu-central-1 with asynchronous model replication.
- Model artifacts: keep model artifacts in customer-controlled S3 with lifecycle rules; Redwood runtime mounts read-only.
- Telemetry: send redacted telemetry to Redwood control plane; option to disable runbook telemetry in Private plan — customer wants opt-in only.

POC scope & success criteria:
- 6-week POC: deploy a 2-node private pool in eu-west-1 behind customer PrivateLink, integrate CMK for encryption, run 24/7 95th-latency test for chat (<120ms target p95), embedding throughput at 50 qps with <200ms median.
- Security gating: successful completion of Redwood security questionnaire, demonstration of KMS integration (customer can rotate CMK), and audit log delivery to customer S3/Bucket with append-only protection.
